title: 22 May 2011. The Arrival of Spring in Woldgate, East Yorkshire in 2011 (twenty eleven) - 22 May “iPad drawing printed on paper" c David Hockney, 2011
medium: Printed on 250gsm Novatech, Gloss coated paper. FSC certified, ECF pulp.

events.n: the iPad drawing this authorised poster reproduces; one of 49, a study of Woldgate, near Bridlington, East Yorkshire
events.q: 22nd May 2011 is a single work from The Arrival of Spring - a 49-part detailed study of the changing seasons in Woldgate, near Bridlington, East Yorkshire.
